::: {.hidden}
{{< include /samples/single-source/personal/_career-chive.qmd >}}

:::

I designed and built a mobile-responsive Next.js application with a backend and cron jobs powered by Supabase, featuring:

- Attachment storage powered by Cloudflare R2. Password protection with built-in login attempt limiting.
- Advanced search functionality with embedded AI assistant powered by Gemini.
- Docs in MDX with Gemini chatbot, API reference implemented with Scalar. 

## Concept

I built CareerChive after using many, many other productivity tool suites to log my daily notes and completed work. No matter what option I chose, the customization process was cumbersome, and manually creating daily entries was tedious. Even after extensive configuration the interfaces did not seem to allow me to capture exactly what I wanted in an intuitive manner, or display analytics in a way that was useful to me in one centralized place.

::: {.callout}
The below embedded demo iframes are interactive mockups, and are not connected to a live backend deployment.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

# Archive

<!-- For each organization you track with CareerChive, you can auto-generate new daily entries for you to fill in, or use the integrated MCP server to assist you with populating your daily entries. Each day allows you to:  -->


For each organization you track with CareerChive, you can auto-generate new daily entries for you to fill in. Each day allows you to:

- Track attendance and reasons for being absent.
- Log completed work and supporting artifacts by each individual item via drag-and-drop editors.
- Enter rich text notes and comments.
- Rate how you felt that day at work. 😠 🙁 😐 🙂 😄

::: {.iframe url="https://careerchive-demo.vercel.app/?org=current&iso=2026-10-21" title="A Sample Daily Log in CareerChive" zoom="50%" new-window="false"}
:::

::: {.iframe url="https://careerchive-demo.vercel.app/?org=current&iso=2026-10-21" title="A Sample Daily Log in CareerChive in Mobile View" zoom="90%" width="70%" new-window="false"}
:::

### Docs Chatbot

In addition to the core user guides, I built a chatbot that answers questions about CareerChive's docs. The chatbot uses Supabase's `pgvector` extension to store the embeddings of the documentation, and the Gemini API to answer questions:

Using feature flags implemented within CareerChive, users can toggle different features of the application on or off, such as gating archive access behind an administrative user for cloud deployment:
